evidence_items.text:
- On his trip to the Ferrari dealership (mentioned 2023-08-03), saw a lot of amazing cars but says his own is the best and he's "pretty proud" of it — "Sure, it's just material, but it reminds me of my hard work and dedication. It really inspires me."; shared a photo of the red car (his Ferrari) lifted on a lift in a garage [S12T7].
- On 2023-08-03, said seeing the car everyday "keeps me motivated and reminds me to keep pushing" [S12T9].
- On 2023-09-22, shared a photo of the red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot — "a sign of my hard work and dedication" — "Looking at it reminds me how far I've come" (shared while comforting Dave over his vintage Mustang engine trouble — details in the Car mod workshop (2023-08-11) section of /memories/dave.md); Dave: "I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it." and asked whether Calvin had any special memories with it; Calvin then recalled an amazing drive "one summer day" — "The wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom - it was unforgettable" [S20T2][S20T3][S20T4].
- On 2023-10-08, shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom while reacting to Dave's car-show story (shared with "Can't wait to check out your garage") [S22T2].
- On 2023-10-15, announced he got a new Ferrari "last week" (~2023-10-09/15) — "a masterpiece on wheels" — and shared a photo of it (a black sports car parked in front of a building) — "Perhaps a photo of this unique beauty will lift your mood."; he's excited for "thrilling rides and unforgettable journeys." (The car in the photo is black, while the Ferrari he has owned since 2023-03-26 is red — either his new car differs in color or it is a second Ferrari; not clarified.) [S23T16]. Dave congratulated him on it ("Must be one amazing ride") and asked him to "share a pic of your new beauty whenever you're ready"; Calvin agreed it "is indeed a showstopper" and said he'd "share a pic soon" [S23T17][S23T18].

- The 2023-09-13 conversation continued: Calvin got excited about the tour stops — "We're hitting some awesome spots - it's gonna be epic!"; Dave said live music is the best and was sure Calvin would have a blast on tour and make awesome memories ("Keep rockin'!"), and offered to show Calvin around his garage and its cool cars (renewing his long-standing offer to show Calvin some cars when he comes to Boston — details in ## Boston; Calvin's side in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave shared a photo of the garage (a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign) — "Check out pic of my garage, it looks stunning!" — and said "Can't wait for your visit! Take care and keep creating amazing music!"; Calvin accepted the offer ("I'll definitely take you up on that offer") and re-pledged to let Dave know when he's in Boston; the chat closed with mutual goodbyes — Dave: "Thanks again for your help. Bye! Have a great day." and "Catch you later", and Calvin: "No problem! Always good chatting with you. Have an awesome day!" [S18T9][S18T10][S18T11][S18T12][S18T13][S18T14][S18T15][S18T16].
- On 2023-09-15, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! Long time no talk!"): told him the night before (2023-09-14) was a blast — he and his band were jamming, "the music just kept flowing," and "had so much fun rehearsing" — and shared that he had attended a rock concert in Boston last weekend (~2023-09-09/10) with an "amazing atmosphere" (photo of a band performing on stage with bright lights) (details in ## Rock band and ## Music); Calvin asked whether there were recordings, but Dave: "I wish we had recorded the jam, but we were way too into it and totally forgot" — Calvin: "Aww, bummer! I would've loved to hear that music," adding that "some of the best memories can't be captured on video or audio" — "those special moments that stay in our hearts and minds" — and then shared a Ratatouille Disney poster (photo of a Disney movie poster with a chef); Dave: "Wow, that's a gorgeous poster!" — it reminded him of one of his favorite Disney movies (implied to be Ratatouille), "I love the lesson it teaches about following your dreams no matter what others say," and he asked whether Calvin had seen it (details in ## Movies); Calvin said Ratatouille is one of his favorites — "It's all about going after what you love, no matter what anyone says" — then brought up Dave's car hobby ("Last time we talked, you mentioned your car hobby - how's that going?"); Dave: "It's been awesome" — "Been restoring this vintage beauty" — and shared the final result photo (a man standing next to a classic car) (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin: "Nice work, Dave! That looks amazing. Is it satisfying to see your hard work pay off?" [S19T1][S19T2][S19T3][S19T4][S19T5][S19T6][S19T7][S19T8]. Dave answered: "It's so satisfying to see this brought back to life," especially seeing people's reactions when they see the finished product — "makes all the hard work worth it" [S19T9]; Calvin: "Dave, it's awesome seeing people happy thanks to you! Fixing cars is such an art. You're inspiring - keep up the good work!" [S19T10]; Dave: "It means a lot that you appreciate what I do. I'm glad that I can make people happy and that's what I'm gonna keep doing." — and had to go, "I have a lot of work to do! Take care!" [S19T11]; the conversation closed with Calvin: "You're really talented, Dave. Keep making people happy and doing what you love. That's what it's all about. See you soon, have a nice one!" [S19T12].
- On 2023-09-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Hey Calvin, good to catch up again!"): told Calvin he'd been working on the engine of the vintage Mustang — thought he'd fixed it, but when he started it up he heard a weird noise — "So disappointing after putting so much work in" — and shared a photo of the engine (a car engine with a small engine), asking Calvin to take a look (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin sympathized ("That must be disappointing after putting so much work into it") and shared a photo of his red sports car (Ferrari) parked in a parking lot as "a sign of my hard work and dedication"; Dave: "I love the way the sunlight hits this. It's definitely a great symbol of all your hard work. I bet you feel really proud when you look at it." and asked whether Calvin had any special memories with it; Calvin recalled an unforgettable summer drive ("the wind blowing through my hair and the rush of freedom") and said his trip to Japan was incredible — "already longing to go back," "an experience that made all the hard work worth it" (Calvin's side in the New luxury car and Japan plan sections of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "That feeling of freedom in the summer is the best. A moment of reflection not only makes the journey interesting but also productive!" — and asked whether any song from Calvin's childhood brings back memories; Calvin: "there's this one song that always makes me smile. It played during a road trip with my dad and we had so much fun singing along to it."; Dave: "Sounds awesome, Calvin! Road trips with family are always a treat. What's the name of the song?"; Calvin: "We used to rock a song by Tupac and Dr. Dre called 'California Love.' Ah, those were the days!" (song details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Sounds great, Cal! 'California Love' is a classic! Let me know if you wanna jam some music together!" — inviting Calvin to jam some music together (details in ## Music); Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! That would be awesome."; Dave: "I'm stoked, Calvin! We can crank up the music and have an awesome jam session. Can't wait!"; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Gonna be great! Can't wait to see what we can do."; Dave: "Yeah, let's do it! It'll be awesome. Let's rock it!"; Calvin: "Yeah, let's do this! I can't wait!"; the conversation closed with Dave: "Nice one, Calvin! Let's make some awesome memories and have a great time. See ya soon!", and Calvin: "Count me in. Can't wait to create something special. See you soon!", and Dave's final parting: "Yep, Calvin! Can't wait to see you soon. Take it easy till then." [S20T1][S20T2][S20T3][S20T4][S20T5][S20T6][S20T7][S20T8][S20T9][S20T10][S20T11][S20T12][S20T13][S20T14][S20T15][S20T16][S20T17].
- On 2023-10-04, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Dave!"): Calvin told him he met with "incredible" artists in Boston the day before (2023-10-03) and talked about working together, and is stoked to collaborate with them on new music (details in the Music section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Awesome, Calvin! Connecting with all those talented artists must have been an inspiring experience. Can't wait to hear what you come up with in your collaboration. Let me know how it goes!" and asked how Calvin arranged the meeting; Calvin: it was through their mutual friend who "knew we'd be a great fit," and "Can't wait to show you the final result." The chat then turned to relaxing hobbies: Calvin said he loves working on a car project "to chill out" and shared a photo of a shiny orange car with its hood open; Dave: "Wow, Calvin, that car looks great! Working on cars really helps me relax, it's therapeutic to see them come back to life" and told him he's been restoring the Ford Mustang he found in a junkyard — "it was in bad shape, but I knew it had potential" (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin: "It's awesome that you can bring things back to life" and asked for photos of it looking amazing; Dave shared a photo of a red car parked in a field with other cars — "I put in a lot of work restoring it, but the result is awesome. It's so satisfying to bring an old car back to life." Calvin: "We've been greatly privileged to have been granted this opportunity. It's so satisfying to bring it back to life!" and shared a photo of dirty hands next to a car; Dave shared a photo of his hands after a day in the garage — "permanently stained with grease. But it's worth it when you see the end result."; Calvin: "Yeah, Dave! Those hands show you worked hard. You put in lots of effort. You should definitely be proud!", and Dave thanked him, saying he loves being able to transform something old and beat-up into something beautiful and that it's the small successes that make him feel proud and fulfilled (details in ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); the two closed the chat with mutual encouragement — both agreed it's motivating and inspiring to see the progress and development in their projects and in themselves, that hard work, dedication, and determination are key to reaching their goals and potential and what sets them apart, and that they'll never give up and keep pushing for more — Calvin: "Let's never give up and keep striving for success... Onwards to our goals!" and Dave: "It's really motivating and keeps me pushing for more." and "Let's keep going! We won't lose focus on our goals. Hard work and determination will get us there. Let's do this!"; the chat then closed with final goodbyes — Calvin: "Yeah, let's do it! Let's stay focused and work hard to make our dreams happen. We can make it happen together! Wishing you all the best until we meet again!" and Dave: "Yep, Calvin! Together, we can do amazing things if we work together and stay motivated. We got this! Take care and stay well!" [S21T1][S21T2][S21T3][S21T4][S21T5][S21T6][S21T7][S21T8][S21T9][S21T10][S21T11][S21T12][S21T13][S21T14][S21T15][S21T16][S21T17][S21T18].
- On 2023-10-08, caught up with Calvin ("Hey Calvin! What's up?"): told him that last Friday (2023-10-06) he went to a car show — saw some awesome cars, got to mess with car mods, and there were so many cool machines around — "it was so much fun!" — and shared a photo of "this beautiful car" (a photography of two men looking at a car engine); Calvin: "Hey Dave, that sounds awesome! I'm into the rush of awesome cars. Can't wait to check out your garage." (shared a photo of a red sports car parked in a showroom) [S22T1][S22T2]. Dave: "Thanks! Yeah, this one looks great!" and said he restored and modified the car himself, adding a custom exhaust and some performance upgrades — it's "got a sweet sound" and he's "really proud of how it turned out"; Calvin: "Wow, Dave! You really turned it into a masterpiece. Impressive!" (shared a photo of a car driving down a street with a traffic light) [S22T3][S22T4]. Dave: "Thanks Calvin! I've spent a lot of time and effort on it. It's not just a hobby, it's a passion. It's like therapy, a way to get away from everyday stress." and added that as a kid he'd spend hours in his dad's garage tinkering with engines — "it was like my own sanctuary" — and now he's "lucky enough to do this as a job, to take something broken and make it into something awesome" (details in ## Classic cars and ## Hobbies and sense of purpose); Calvin: "Wow, Dave, that's amazing. Bringing broken things back to life is so satisfying. Working on cars can be a real escape from reality, and I understand that feeling. Doing what you love for a living, that's the ultimate goal, right? Keep going with it, it's really inspiring." [S22T5][S22T6]. Dave: "Thanks, Calvin. It's been my goal since I was a kid and it's awesome to be able to do something I love. Restoring things like this can be tough but the feeling of accomplishment it gives is great. Absolutely, I'm loving it." Calvin: "Go for it, Dave! Chasing your dreams is what life's about. It's awesome to see how far you've come. Keep working hard and living your best life." (Calvin's side of this whole exchange in the 2023-10-08 entry of ## Relationships in /memories/calvin.md) [S22T7][S22T8].

- On 2023-05-01, said he'd love to check Dave's shop out sometime and asked what sort of cars he works on (Dave: all kinds, from regular maintenance to full restorations of classic cars) [S4T17][S4T18][S4T19].
- The 2023-05-01 conversation closed with Calvin praising Dave's work ("Keep up the great work!" / "Keep on keepin' on, bud!") after Dave said his work is valued and brings joy to others; Calvin then shared a photo of a gold necklace with a diamond pendant (see ## Jewelry) [S4T22][S4T23][S4T24].
- On 2023-05-03, reconnected with Dave ("long time no talk") and congratulated him on teaming up with a local garage — "super inspiring seeing [Dave] follow [his] passion", "congratulations on this new venture", "impressive how far [Dave has] come since [they] last chatted"; called the car Dave was working on "awesome" with "a lot of effort" behind it, asked about his plans for next, cheered on Dave's dream of building a custom car ("sounds awesome"), and told him to relax and enjoy the process; when Dave asked how he unwinds, said long drives in his red sports car help him relax (details in ## New luxury car (Ferrari, 2023-03-26) and /memories/dave.md) [S5T1][S5T2][S5T3][S5T4][S5T6][S5T7][S5T8].
- The 2023-05-03 conversation ended with Calvin thanking Dave for the creativity advice ("taking a break is great for getting my mojo back"), saying he won't give up, and "let's stay in touch"; Dave encouraged him to keep pursuing his music and said Calvin can reach out anytime if he needs help [S5T12][S5T13][S5T14][S5T15].
- On 2023-05-16, reconnected with Dave ("long time no chat") and told him the flood had been tough but that he's staying positive; shared his studio photo, asked Dave what exciting projects he's working on, and Dave excitedly told him about the shop's celebration — the two wished each other well (Calvin: "Can't wait to get back to making music") [S6T1][S6T3][S6T5][S6T6][S6T7][S6T8].
